caption: Worked example 1: each block gives degree d, diameter D and bisection width B. The 3-cube has the best diameter (D = 3 hops); the binary tree has the worst bottleneck (B = 1 link).

spec.aria: Three blocks compare a 2×4 mesh, an 8-node binary tree and a 3-cube, each showing degree d, diameter D and bisection width B; the cube has the smallest diameter and the tree the smallest bisection width.
